title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
constraints: numbers is sorted in non-decreasing order.
The tests are generated such that there is exactly one solution.
Returned indices are 1-based, not JavaScript array offsets.

examples.explanation: The two equal zeroes are different elements.

solutionApproaches.title: Check Every Pair
solutionApproaches.explanation: Try every pair of positions; correct but ignores the useful sorted-order guarantee.

solutionApproaches.title: Two Pointers
solutionApproaches.explanation: One pointer at each end. Advance left if sum < target, move right inward if sum > target.
